[SWS_CM_00827] Default value of Minimum Send Interval and disabling Min- imum Send Interval time monitoring for SetHandlers for Clients
⌈
If the config-
ured Minimum Send Interval (ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement.minimum-
SendInterval) of a Set() of the respective field class has the value 0, the Minimum
Send Interval monitoring shall not be active for the corresponding Field::Set(),
i.e., ara::com will not limit the Tx frequency by dropping Field::Set() calls by the client. For each Field of a ServiceInterfaceDeployment, 0 shall be the de-
fault value for the corresponding ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement.mini-
mumSendInterval. This means that unless ServiceInterfaceDeploymentEle-
ment.minimumSendInterval for a given method is explicitly configured to be > 0,
the Tx rate is not limited by ara::com.
⌋
